description: This file defines an enumeration CommonMdcEntryKey that specifies MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entry keys used for logging purposes. It contains a single enum constant for a correlation ID key, along with methods to access its string representation.

classes.name: CommonMdcEntryKey
classes.description: An enumeration of commonly known MDC entry keys used for structured logging, implementing CharSequence for easy string manipulation and retrieval.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index within the key string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string from start to end indices.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key.
